teachingQuestion: Where should a design team look for plausible abuse paths?
focalInsight: Threat-modeling value comes from examining assets and flows at trust boundaries, then assigning mitigations and residual-risk decisions.
title: Review data flows at trust boundaries
caption: A boundary is where trust, authority, or control changes—not merely a box on a network diagram.
altSummary: An external partner sends an upload through a gateway and trust boundary to an internal processor and protected store; an administrative path changes gateway policy.
textFallback: Map the partner, gateway, boundary, processor, storage, and administration path. At the external-to-internal boundary, ask what identity, content, replay, availability, and authorization assumptions change. Assign a mitigation, test, or residual-risk owner for each plausible abuse path.
